valid_questions.prompt: Processing 'a  b  c' with value.replace('  ', '|', 1).strip() yields 'a|b  c'. If this result is passed to text.split() with no arguments, what is returned?
valid_questions.explanation: split() with no arguments splits on any whitespace and discards empties. In 'a|b  c', the pipe is not whitespace, so the only split point is the double space before 'c'. The result is ['a|b', 'c'].
